name: Mera Multi
description: Mera Multi is an open multimodal evaluation framework for Russian-language architectures, covering text, image, audio, and video modalities with 18 newly constructed tasks designed to assess multimodal abilities with attention to Russian cultural and linguistic specificity.
reputation: A new Russian multimodal benchmark with promising scope, but still early in adoption and not yet a de facto standard.
notes: Includes a universal taxonomy of multimodal abilities and methodology to prevent benchmark leakage; focuses on Russian language but methodology is replicable.
